query:
-- Measure for Measure
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Measure for Measure, Shakespeare, New Swan Theatre, minimalist, unit set'
WHERE slug = 'measure-for-measure';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'measure-for-measure'
AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', 'Minimalist', 'Unit Set', 'Theatre Festival', '2021');
